judge.method: self-judged visual inspection of the Chrome render; strict per-requirement pass/fail

requirements.text: Create a wooden barrel with visible vertical planks and two horizontal metal hoops.
requirements.note: Three horizontal metal hoops are visible, not two.

requirements.text: The barrel must be buried in a mound of sand, so only the top half is visible.
requirements.note: More than the top half of the barrel is visible above the sand.

requirements.text: Show the sand mounded up slightly around the visible base of the barrel.
requirements.note: Mounded sand visibly surrounds the lower barrel.

requirements.text: The barrel must be open at the top and filled with treasure items.
requirements.note: The open barrel top is filled with coins and gemstones.

requirements.text: Show treasure overflowing from the top and spilling down one side of the barrel onto the sand.
requirements.note: The few exterior coins do not visibly overflow from the top or spill down a barrel side.

requirements.text: The treasure must include a large pile of shiny gold coins, both inside and outside the barrel.
requirements.note: Only a few coins are outside the barrel, not a large exterior pile.

requirements.text: Add a variety of colorful gemstones (red rubies, green emeralds, blue sapphires) mixed in with the coins.
requirements.note: Red and blue-toned gems are visible, but no green emerald is visible.

requirements.text: A string of white pearls must be draped over the edge of the barrel, trailing down into the spilled coins.
requirements.note: No draped string of white pearls is visible.

requirements.text: A golden goblet must be visible, partially buried in the coins inside the barrel.
requirements.note: No golden goblet is visible among the coins.

requirements.text: Use bright highlights and glint effects on the coins, gems, and goblet to make them look shiny.
requirements.note: Coins and gems are highlighted, but the required goblet is absent.
